## For Markdown Files (.md)

Add at the bottom of documentation files:

```markdown

```

## Usage Instructions

When creating new files:
1. Copy the appropriate template for your file type
2. Add the copyright header at the top (for code) or bottom (for docs)
3. Include a brief description of the module/file purpose
4. Ensure copyright year is current
